ethereum-protocol-specs-and-clients.selection_rule: All execution and consensus client repositories named in the ethereum.org Nodes and Clients tables, plus the canonical execution specification, execution API, and consensus specification repositories linked by ethereum.org and the execution-specs project. The EIPs source repository is excluded from the candidate set by the task definition.

opentelemetry-language-sdks-and-collecto.selection_rule: All language API/SDK repositories named in OpenTelemetry community membership, plus the two official Collector repositories. Auto-instrumentation, documentation, demo, and contrib-only language instrumentation repositories are outside this catalog rule.

rust-governed-toolchain.selection_rule: Rust compiler, package manager, formatter, linter, IDE front end, interpreter, trait solver, and borrow-checking research implementation repositories managed by the corresponding Rust project teams. Application libraries and inactive experiments are outside this catalog rule.
